name: Hidden Grove
summary: Wild moonkin now guard the Hidden Grove in northeastern Winterspring.

sections.title: A Secluded Sanctuary
sections.body:
Cliffs shelter the Hidden Grove from Winterspring’s bitter winds. Snow-dusted trees fill the sunken crater, nearly cut off from the world beyond. Its hidden rim is hard to reach. You must risk a steep drop or find a narrow cavern passage in the southeastern ridge.

White hares once lived undisturbed in the valley. Now aggressive wild moonkin have taken the glade, and unwary travelers may be ambushed there.

faq.q: How do you get into the Hidden Grove?
faq.answer: The safest way into the Hidden Grove is through a concealed cave in the southeastern cliff face. You can scramble down the steep rim, but a fall could be fatal.

faq.q: What creatures live in the Hidden Grove?
faq.answer: Hostile wild moonkin now guard the Hidden Grove. Before they came, harmless white hares lived peacefully in the glade.

faq.q: Where in Winterspring is this grove located?
faq.answer: The Hidden Grove lies in far northeastern Winterspring, enclosed by towering stone cliffs.

angles.text: As a druid, you may see the crater’s moonkin as wild nature turned fiercely defensive. Their presence may raise spiritual questions.
